completion_promises.criterion_text: Signatures and behaviour above; no disk I/O (bytes in/bytes out)
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented AudioClient with __init__(config, *, transport), transcribe(audio, *, filename, content_type), and synthesize(text, *, response_format) methods. All methods work with pure bytes - transcribe takes bytes and returns str, synthesize takes str and returns bytes. No disk I/O anywhere in the implementation.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Wire-seam pins assert on the captured raw request body, not just "was called"
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented MockAudioTransport that captures raw request body in last_request_body. Tests verify: (1) STT multipart contains exact strings 'name="file"', 'filename="q.ogg"', 'audio/ogg;codecs=opus', 'name="model"' in raw bytes, (2) TTS JSON body parsed and verified for model, voice, input, response_format fields. Seam tests marked with @pytest.mark.seam and @pytest.mark.integration_contract decorators.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Both failure legs collapse to VoiceUnavailable; timeout honoured at 10 s
completion_promises.evidence: All httpx exceptions (HTTPStatusError, RequestError, TimeoutException) are caught and re-raised as VoiceUnavailable with context message. Fresh httpx.AsyncClient created per call with timeout=httpx.Timeout(config.audio_timeout_seconds) where audio_timeout_seconds=10.0 from VoiceConfig. Tests verify 503 responses raise VoiceUnavailable for both STT and TTS.
